items.name: Federal statute, enacted appropriation or valid authorization
items.research_question: Determine governing constitutional power, enactment, appropriation, fiscal limits and delegation.

items.name: State/local cooperation or federal funding condition
items.research_question: Determine each jurisdiction's independent authority and constitutional limits on conditional grants; no automatic federal command.

items.name: Personal-data collection, sharing or use
items.research_question: Identify applicable government/private-sector law, consent or other lawful basis, data protection and redress.

items.name: Public acquisition and compensation
items.research_question: Determine necessity of authorizing law, public-use and compensation obligations, and State or federal property rules.

items.name: Civilian/military emergency cyber assistance
items.research_question: Distinguish civilian advisory and defense missions, statutory restrictions, consent and oversight; no general domestic policing power.

items.name: Income, capital or wealth-related federal tax
items.research_question: Examine constitutional classification, statutory enactment, valuation, apportionment issues and administration; feasibility unresolved.

items.name: Executive delegation and program operation
items.research_question: Verify whether the named office actually has competence; a Cabinet label or catalog edge is insufficient.

items.name: Potential change beyond current constitutional arrangements
items.research_question: Determine if constitutional amendment is truly required; Article V process is separate from ordinary legislation and policy change.

items.name: Speech-related content, attribution or government influence activity
items.research_question: Document particular authority, compelled disclosure limits, protected speech and contestable evidence rather than government truth criteria.
